Subject: Re: Zenlytics POC - success criteria & next steps

Thanks for the productive call today, Alex — quick recap and proposed plan so we’re all aligned.

Call highlights / agreed success criteria:
- End-to-end latency under 350ms p50 for the 1k sample queries you provided.
- Stable throughput of 60 concurrent requests with ≤10% error rate during simulated load.
- Quality: 85% acceptance rate on your 50 evaluation prompts (per your rubric).

Evaluation plan & ownership:
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): Redwood provides POC plan + environment details (see attached redwood-poc-plan.xlsx) — owner: me.
- Week 1: Data ingest + baseline runs on your sample set — owner: Zenlytics (Alex) + Redwood infra (Marcus).
- Week 2: Integration tests, latency/throughput tuning, and quality tuning with feedback loops — owners: Marcus (infra), Neha (integration).
- Week 3: Final evaluation and handoff + decision checkpoint.

Timeline proposal:
- Preferred kickoff: July 6 (Mon) — short sync + environment access.
- Weekly status on Fridays (15 min) — Marissa/Marcus + Zenlytics engineers.

Immediate asks for kickoff:
1) A representative test dataset (CSV or JSON) and access instructions to their staging service.
2) SSO details or a user to test auth flows (if you want us to validate access).
3) Confirmation on the kickoff slot: July 6, 11:00am PT.

Next steps:
- I’ll spin up the dev endpoint and share credentials ahead of kickoff.
- Marcus will prepare the evaluation checklist and infra runbook.

Attaching: redwood-poc-plan.xlsx (high level milestones + checklist)

Thanks — excited to get this rolling.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
